read: With Wilson intervals attached: decoy uptake under the hidden rubric is 0.125 [0.0546, 0.2611] vs a 0.0 baseline; the naming rate among the 5 drifters is 0.2 [0.0362, 0.6245] under the shared naming detector, i.e. drift is almost entirely silent (an earlier 1.0 came from a degenerate detector disjunct removed in the runner; see its #NAMING-DETECTOR note). Decoy uptake does not differ meaningfully by whether the decoy is option A or B, so position is not doing the work.
